plain: A large survey of people who report contact with non-human beings, run by a group called FREE and named for the astronaut Edgar Mitchell, is said to find that 52 percent of them met creatures that looked roughly human. Michels cites it himself across several episodes, at times saying "over 50%," describing the database as 5,000-plus abductees in the US, and also citing its findings on beings taking tissue samples. He raises it with Mike Masters, who argues in his book The Extratempestrial Model that the visitors may be humans from the future, and he tells it because so many humanlike beings would fit that idea.
